purpose: Provider-neutral handoff for submitting the exact frozen design manifest after the outcome-blind coverage and rights gates pass.

independent_checklist: The provider record is reachable without relying on a private session.
The record identifies the same study and provider identifier recorded here.
The recorded manifest bytes or digest exactly match submission.artifact_sha256.
The provider timestamp is explicit and timezone-aware.
The retained evidence is sufficient for an independent reviewer to repeat the check.

required_preconditions: coverage_probe_spec.v2.json is committed and externally timestamped before probe execution
the bounded outcome-blind probe receipt passes all fixed gates
historical data, official calendar, and data-rights attestation pass review
prior-exposure attestation and design manifest are complete
the manifest is frozen and its exact hash is recorded
forbidden_actions: submitting a draft plan or a modified manifest
using a private or unverifiable timestamp as external registration
inspecting factor outcomes or forward returns to decide whether to register
creating a receipt from this template without a provider-controlled record

trust_boundary: This template is a checklist and contains no registration, timestamp, identifier, or proof. Only a human with access to the external provider may submit and independently verify the record. Null fields cannot authorize Stage 2.
completion_gate: Populate only after an external provider has accepted the exact manifest; retain provider evidence privately where redistribution is restricted, publish only permitted metadata and hashes, and then complete registration_receipt.v1 followed by execution_authorization.v1.
